title: Maximum EMF Value
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for maximum induced EMF must be 600 V.

title: Maximum EMF Formula
description: Important: The student must correctly apply the formula Em = N * B * S * ω, where S is the coil area.

title: Time Function Form
description: Essential: The expression for e(t) must be in the correct trigonometric form (cosine) with the correct amplitude and argument.

title: Angular Velocity Argument
description: Important: The time-dependent argument must correctly use the given ω (100 rad/s) as the coefficient of t.

title: Area Calculation
description: Important: The student must correctly calculate the coil area S from the given side lengths (0.30 m and 0.20 m).

title: Cosine vs Sine Choice
description: Pitfall: Using sine instead of cosine for e(t) without justification, given the initial position shown in the diagram.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: The solution demonstrates consistent use of SI units (meters, teslas, etc.) in calculations.

title: Phase or Constant Error
description: Pitfall: Including an incorrect phase constant or a negative sign in the final e(t) expression without proper reasoning.
